title: Affiliate Disclosure
description: Understand how CounterCrave uses Amazon Associate and other affiliate links.
summary: As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases.

sections.heading: How affiliate links work
paragraphs: Some CounterCrave links are affiliate links. When a reader follows one of these links and completes a qualifying purchase, CounterCrave may earn a commission.
The reader's purchase price is not increased because of this commission.

sections.heading: Editorial independence
paragraphs: Affiliate relationships do not guarantee positive coverage or a recommendation. Products are assessed against the criteria described in our methodology.
CounterCrave aims to disclose meaningful drawbacks, suitable alternatives and situations in which a reader should not buy a product.

sections.heading: Amazon relationship
paragraphs: Amazon and the Amazon logo are trademarks of Amazon.com, Inc. or its affiliates. CounterCrave is not Amazon and does not process Amazon orders, returns or customer service requests.

author: CounterCrave Editorial Team
